title: A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 1, part 3: Thomas Jefferson
summary: "A Compilation of the Messages and Papers of the Presidents. Volume 1, part 3" compiled by James D. Richardson is a historical collection first published in 1899. This volume presents official proclamations, speeches, and messages from America's early presidents. Part 3 specifically covers the conclusion of Andrew Jackson's presidency and the complete term of Martin Van Buren between 1837 and 1841.
